Deployment modes​

Bundles support development and production modes.

Choose a mode per target:

  • Development, for iterating
  • Production, for scheduled runs

    with a service principal

note

Modes are optional.

Development mode​

Set the mode on the target: 

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development

Presets

PresetEffect
name_prefixPrefixes resource names
pipelines_developmentRuns pipelines in development mode
PresetEffect
name_prefixPrefixes resource names
pipelines_developmentRuns pipelines in development mode

Production mode

Production mode validates the deployment.
